findings.title: Invoice still assumes dollars after cents change
findings.description: PriceCalculator.total() now returns cents (long), but InvoiceService.render still treats it as dollars (double total = calculator.total(order); tax = total * 0.2), so invoices show amounts 100x too large; divide by 100.0 or use a Money type.
findings.suggestion: Convert with `total = calculator.total(order) / 100.0` (or format cents) in InvoiceService.
